context: Asuka lectures on clear writing and truth.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing lecture; analytical forms (直接/もと/まさに/正しい/求める) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い文章は、考えを直接伝えます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正しい言葉を、選ぶのが難しいです。
lines.en: Choosing the correct words is hard.
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もとの考えが明確なら、言葉も定まります。
lines.en: If the original idea is clear, the words settle too.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 読者は、何を求めているんでしょう?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 読者は、まさに分かりやすさを求めます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 直接的すぎると、冷たく感じませんか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もとの優しさを、残せば大丈夫です。
lines.en: If you keep the original kindness, it's fine.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まさに、心と論理の両方ですね。
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm realization throughout
